get_itemdescribe:
People have always cared about whether it is dazzling enough to wear as an ornament, yet few know that it holds a snowflake of the purest kind within.
Legend says it carries the heartfelt wish of a snowman.

A twirl, a curtsy, and a dress that sways gently with every breath. Another picture-perfect ball begins.
But in this moment, you know you don't have to care about the eyes of the crowd. This opening dance is for you, and you alone.

Rise lightly onto your toes as every gaze around you gathers like a spotlight.
One, two, three... Your steps remain soft and graceful as you make your way to the center of the dance floor.

A towel turban from The Named Springs.
Soft and warm, it gently cares for every strand.

A commemorative feather fan from The Named Springs.
"The Way of Immortality cherishes life and offers salvation to all." They say only those bound to Mr. Heyu by fate may possess one.

A bathrobe from The Named Springs.
Hot springs are wonderful, but be careful not to soak for too long.
A tribute piece modeled after a renowned gem artisan's mattock. Its fluorite accents emit a faint blue glow in the moonlight, making it especially striking.

A faint line of text can be seen inside the hat:
"Mine safe, crack safe!"
They look sharp and sturdy, but once you put them on, why do you suddenly feel like... cracking open some rocks?

A flawless wand of crystalline clarity, appearing each year at the Ball of Perfection ceremony. The snowflake at its tip shines with such pure brilliance that it seems to reflect the deepest dreams hidden in every heart.
Fearless one, having donned the crest of the stars, are you ready to set sail into the endless blue of the Starsea?
May all who journey through the boundless Starsea be guided by starlight.
On every mysterious isle and uncharted shore, the stars will leave their footprints behind.
As you sail the Starsea, hold tight to the oars, and tighter still to the heart that never stops wondering.
Through its mysterious lens, does the Starsea before your eyes seem deeper and more radiant than the one charted on maps of old?
Shimmering shooting stars favor fearless hearts. Whenever one passes by, it brushes the cheek of a new voyager with a gentle kiss of blessing.
From each ear hangs a star that never sets, lighting the way ahead for travelers who have lost their way.
Deep blue stardust fell upon the girl's cheeks, a final, sorrowful kiss before the planet's end.
An azure star chimes softly by your ear, whispering of the Starsea's endless mysteries.
Every star must have tried its very best to grow so round, so bright, and so full. Be sure to put on your glasses and take a good, close look.
Stars, oh stars, why are you secretly holding my hand? Are you a little afraid of the dark too?

"Tap, tap, tap..."
Who danced through the night along the galaxy, sending stars tumbling from the sky in a glittering shower?
A journey across the Starsea, and forever after, the colors of deep space and the morning stars linger upon you.

Stars settle upon the bow, swaying softly with each step, lingering, lingering, unwilling to leave. Then... let us go,
and wander the Starsea together.
